title: Pure Signer Dragon
summary: The Signer Dragon strategy unites the six legendary Dragons of Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's—Stardust Dragon, Red Dragon Archfiend, Black Rose Dragon, Ancient Fairy Dragon, Black-Winged Dragon, and Life Stream Dragon—under the banner of Level 12 Crimson Dragon! Normal Summon any Level 4 starter (such as Stardust Synchron or Junk Synchron) and use Level 3 Revolution Synchron directly from your hand as Synchro Material to summon Level 7 Ancient Fairy Dragon or Power Tool Dragon. Revolution Synchron then mills 1 card to revive itself from your GY as a Level 1 Tuner, tuning with your Level 7 Dragon into Level 8 Stardust Dragon or Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon! Finally, pair a Level 4 Tuner with a Level 8 Signer Dragon to summon Level 12 Crimson Dragon, which searches Synchro Rumble and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect during your opponent's turn to cheat out Black Rose Dragon (for a Turn-0 board wipe!) or Cosmic Blazar Dragon!

allow.Converging Wills Dragon: Level 1 LIGHT Dragon Tuner that Special Summons itself when drawn and summons a Level 1 Dragon/Synchron from your Deck to Synchro Summon Shooting Majestic Star Dragon or Crimson Dragon.
allow.Tuning: Normal Spell that adds any 'Synchron' Tuner (Stardust Synchron, Revolution Synchron, or Junk Synchron) from your Deck to your hand and mills the top card of your Deck.
allow.Arrive in Light: Continuous Spell searched by Stardust Synchron that places Converging Wills Dragon on top of your Deck and draws a card or summons a Tuner when a Synchro is Special Summoned.
allow.Living Fossil: Equip Spell searched by Power Tool Dragon that revives a Level 4 or lower Tuner/non-Tuner from your GY to extend into Level 8 Life Stream Dragon and Level 12 Crimson Dragon!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Junk Synchron or Doppelwarrior.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Jet Synchron or Converging Wills Dragon from your Deck.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Stardust Synchron or Revolution Synchron to the GY.
allow.Doppelwarrior: Level 2 Warrior that Special Summons itself from your hand when a monster is revived from your GY (by Junk Synchron, Stardust Synchron, or Synchro Rumble) and spawns 2 Level 1 Doppel Tokens when used as Synchro Material!
allow.Junk Speeder: Level 5 Synchro (1 Synchron Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners) that Special Summons Stardust Synchron, Revolution Synchron, Junk Synchron, Assault Synchron, and Jet Synchron directly from your Deck!

main: Stardust Synchron

Core Level 4 LIGHT Machine Tuner: tributes 1 monster to Special Summon itself from your hand OR GY, and searches ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'Stardust Dragon' (Arrive in Light or Stardust Illumination!) on Normal or Special Summon!
Revolution Synchron

Core Level 3 EARTH Machine Tuner: if you Synchro Summon a Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro Monster (Ancient Fairy Dragon or Black Rose Dragon) or a 'Power Tool' Synchro Monster, this card in your HAND can be used as material; then mills 1 card while you control a Level 7+ Synchro to revive itself as a Level 1 Tuner!
Junk Synchron
Classic Level 3 DARK Warrior Tuner: revives a Level 2 or lower monster from your GY on Normal Summon to climb into Level 5 Junk Speeder or Level 7/8 Signer Dragons.
Jet Synchron
Level 1 FIRE Machine Tuner: searches a Junk monster when used as Synchro Material, or discards 1 card to revive itself from your GY.
Assault Synchron

Level 2 DARK Machine Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand for 700 LP; and if a face-up Dragon Synchro Monster you control is Tributed or banished (such as when Stardust Dragon tributes itself to negate destruction, or when Crimson Dragon tags out!), banishes itself from your GY to immediately Special Summon that Dragon back!
Stardust Trail

Level 4 LIGHT Dragon non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand or GY whenever a monster you control is Tributed (such as by Stardust Synchron or Stardust Dragon!), and spawns a Level 1 Stardust Token when used to Synchro Summon a Warrior, Synchron, or Stardust Synchro!
Doppelwarrior
Special Summons itself from hand when a monster is revived from your GY and generates 2 Level 1 Tokens on Synchro Summon.
Converging Wills Dragon
Level 1 Dragon Tuner summoned via Arrive in Light to climb into Shooting Majestic Star Dragon.
Tuning
Searches Stardust Synchron, Revolution Synchron, or Junk Synchron and mills 1 card.
Synchro Overtake
Limited to 1 in TCG: reveals Junk Speeder or Stardust Dragon in your Extra Deck to add or Special Summon Junk Synchron from your Deck or GY.
Synchro Rumble
Searched by Crimson Dragon on Synchro Summon: targets 1 Tuner OR 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro Monster (any Signer Dragon!) in your GY and Special Summons it in Defense Position!
Stardust Illumination

Searched by Stardust Synchron: sends a 'Stardust' monster from your Deck to the GY (or Special Summons it if you control Stardust Dragon!), and banishes itself from GY to adjust a Stardust monster's Level by 1!
Arrive in Light

Continuous Spell searched by Stardust Synchron: places Converging Wills Dragon on top of your Deck, prevents your Synchro Monsters from returning to the Extra Deck, and draws 1 card or Special Summons a Tuner when a Synchro Monster is Special Summoned!
Living Fossil
Revealed as 3 copies by Power Tool Dragon to guarantee adding 1 to your hand, reviving a monster from your GY to extend into Life Stream Dragon and Crimson Dragon!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Junk Synchron or Doppelwarrior.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Jet Synchron or Converging Wills Dragon from your Deck.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Stardust Synchron or Stardust Trail to the GY.
extra: Ultimate Level 12 LIGHT Dragon Synchro god: searches Synchro Rumble on Special Summon; Quick Effect to target 1 Level 7 or higher Synchro Monster on the field, return itself to the Extra Deck, and Special Summon 1 Dragon Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level (treated as a Synchro Summon!)!

Yusei's Level 8 WIND Dragon Signer Dragon (2500 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy any card or effect that would destroy a card(s) on the field, and revives itself during the End Phase!

Level 8 WIND Dragon Synchro: revives a Level 2 or lower Tuner on Synchro Summon, and tributes itself during the Main Phase (Quick Effect) to Special Summon 'Stardust Dragon' from your Extra Deck and immediately Synchro Summon a Synchro Monster unaffected by opponent's activated effects!
Jack Atlas's Level 8 DARK Dragon Signer Dragon (3000 ATK): destroys all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls after damage calculation.

Level 8 DARK Dragon Signer evolution (treated as 'Red Dragon Archfiend' on field/GY): destroys all other Special Summoned Effect Monsters on the field with ATK less than or equal to this card's and burns for 500 each!

Akiza's Level 7 FIRE Dragon Signer Dragon (2400 ATK): when Synchro Summoned (including during your opponent's turn via Crimson Dragon targeting a Level 7 Ancient Fairy Dragon or Power Tool Dragon!), destroys ALL cards on the field!

Luna's Level 7 LIGHT Dragon Signer Dragon (2100 ATK / 3000 DEF; Unlimited in TCG): Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand once per turn, and destroys Field Spells to gain 1000 LP and search a Field Spell.

Crow's Level 8 DARK Dragon Signer Dragon (2800 ATK): absorbs any effect damage you would take as Black Feather Counters and removes counters to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK and inflict burn damage.

Leo's Level 7 EARTH Machine Dragon (2300 ATK): reveals 3 copies of Living Fossil from your Deck to add 1 to your hand, and tunes with a Level 1 Tuner (revived Revolution Synchron!) into Life Stream Dragon!

Leo's Level 8 EARTH Dragon Signer Dragon ('1 Tuner + "Power Tool Dragon"'; 2900 ATK): sets your LP to 4000 on Synchro Summon, makes all effect damage you take 0, and banishes Equips from GY to prevent Synchro destruction.
Level 5 Synchro (1 Synchron Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners) that Special Summons Stardust Synchron, Revolution Synchron, Junk Synchron, Assault Synchron, and Jet Synchron directly from your Deck!
